description: Kiokun translation model evaluation artifacts. JSON detail files contain selected current-bad examples, candidate translations, and blind judge scores. CSV files contain consensus-current-bad rows for quick inspection.
notes: large-strict excludes GPT-5.5 because OpenAI quota was exhausted during the run; it compares Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and Gemini 3.5 Flash.
small-gpt includes GPT-5.5 plus Claude/Gemini on a smaller consensus-current-bad sample.
Earlier Cloudflare Workers AI experiments are discussed qualitatively in the blog post; they were not included in the large blind judge dataset.
